props.name: error_message
props.meaning: Draws the line under the control.

props.name: value
props.meaning: The raw attribute value, as the API returned it. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: on_value_change
props.meaning: Called when the editor commits.

props.name: data_type
props.meaning: Picks the editor.

props.name: field
props.meaning: The field schema.

props.name: mode
props.meaning: Which half is showing. Two-way in Svelte, controlled in React.

props.name: on_mode_change
props.meaning: Called when the toggle moves.

props.name: editable
props.meaning: Turns the display half into a control that opens the editor.

props.name: editor_placement
props.meaning: Where the editor opens: in place of the value, or in a popover anchored to it.

props.name: statuses
props.meaning: Status rows by code, for the display half.

props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context: the site preferences, and what the display half reads.

props.name: hours_per_day
props.meaning: The site's working day, for durations.

props.name: locale
props.meaning: Passed to the display half.

props.name: time_zone
props.meaning: Zone a typed wall-clock time is read in.

props.name: frame_rate
props.meaning: Frames a second, for timecodes.

props.name: precision
props.meaning: Decimals on a float.

props.name: symbol
props.meaning: Shown before a currency value.

props.name: project_id
props.meaning: Removes a list field's hidden values, and scopes a status or entity picker.

props.name: multiline
props.meaning: A textarea on a text field. In a textarea Enter adds a line and Cmd or Ctrl with Enter commits.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Control height.

props.name: invalid
props.meaning: Forced invalid state.

props.name: error
props.meaning: A message from the caller.

props.name: on_error_change
props.meaning: Called when the parse error appears or clears.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Marker the display half shows for an unset value.

keyboard.does: Opens the editor from the display half; commits and closes it from the edit half.
Opens the editor from the display half.
Cancels the edit and returns to the display half.
Commits and returns to the display half, unless focus stays inside a popup the editor opened.
Commits and returns to the display half.
Cancels and commits as they do in place; Save and Cancel do the same with the pointer.
